the Nueva coronía is an illustrated manuscript that Guaman Poma produced in order to communicate his vision of a good government for his people, the indigenous Andeans.4 The work is divided into 12 sections, each of which is introduced by a title page that includes an image and a text.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Guaman Poma was not only a skilled artist, but he was also a skilled fashion designer.
Guaman Poma was not just a writer and artist, but also a self-portraitist.
